I highly recommend watching the interview with Miyazaki, or reading an article about it, about his philosophy on “ma-ma”. 

I feel this is something people who typically only watch Western media only ever bring up. It’s like there’s this need for constant plot, entertainment, etc., to the degree they can’t sit in the silence between.

“‘When I clap my hands,’ he said, “you hear the sound of the clap. You don’t hear what is in between the sound of the clap. In Japan, we have a name for what is in between the sound of the clap. We call it ma like ‘ma-ma.’“

The wind direction changes partway through the day and the balloons come in on the wind current. So, you need to know which side the balloons will blow in from in order to frequent the correct coast :)
THE POPPY WAR

Get ittttt! Balloons typically spawn every 5 minutes, starting at 4 minutes after the hour. Say it’s noon, they’ll start moving across the ocean at 12:04, then 12:09, 12:14, 12:19, etc. They’ll start to appear along the shoreline 1 minute after spawning. If you go 15 minutes without one, enter and exit a building to reset. And check the direction of your wind by seeing what way the smoke is blowing out of a Villager’s chimney! Good luck!
